evidence.title: Impeccable: The missing design vocabulary for agents

name: Impeccable
summary: Design guidance for AI coding agents: one skill, 23 commands, live browser iteration and 61 detector rules against AI slop.
description: A skill for AI coding agents that adds a shared design vocabulary: /impeccable init records product truth in PRODUCT.md and /impeccable document writes DESIGN.md, while 23 commands (craft, shape, critique, audit, polish, animate, typeset, layout …) shape, review and refine frontend work. A deterministic detector of 61 rules runs without an LLM and is wired into a design hook on UI edits in Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor and Grok Build.
contains: 61 deterministic detector rules, no LLM or API key
install via npx impeccable install or plugin marketplaces
design hook for Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, Cursor and Grok Build
